latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Enables seamless setup and management of top Chinese AI models via AIsa in OpenClaw.

- Adds AIsa as a first-class model provider, supporting MiniMax, Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi K2.5, and Doubao through official partnerships.
- Provides step-by-step setup instructions, including environment variable and configuration file options.
- Pre-configures popular models (Qwen3 Max, DeepSeek V3.1, Kimi K2.5) with up-to-date pricing, context window, and usage details.
- Introduces enterprise-grade Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for Kimi K2.5, ensuring privacy when accessed via AIsa.
- Documents pricing comparisons, temperature limitations, and expanded catalog access for all supported Chinese LLMs.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for AIsa integration and guidance on comparing providers.
